biotools.summary: TaxaNorm is an R package implementing a novel feature-wise normalization method for microbiome sequencing data based on a zero-inflated negative binomial model. It addresses limitations of existing methods by accounting for taxon-specific effects of sequencing depth and offers diagnostic tests to validate the varying depth effect.
